name: Scarecrow

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You fight fiercely to protect your crop. When you hit a creature that is adjacent to two or more members of your crop with a weapon or unarmed attack, you gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice. If the creature has a member of your crop Grabbed or Restrained, that member can attempt to Escape as a reaction.
